Job description




TCS Hiring | Gen AI Developer | Kolkata | 5 to 12 Yrs | Face to Face Interview





Exciting Opportunity with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)!





We are hiring experienced Gen AI Developer for a Face-to-Face Walk-in Drive in Kolkata.





Interview Details




Date: 11th July 2026 (Saturday)

Mode: Face-to-Face Interview

Location: Kolkata

Experience: 5 to 12 Years




Role: Gen AI Developer





We are looking for passionate engineers who thrive in a fast-paced environment and are eager to build scalable, cloud-native applications.





Job description:




Technical/Functional Skills:



Strong knowledge of Generative AI concepts including foundation models / LLMs, embeddings, and NLP fundamentals used in GenAI solutions.
Design, implement, and optimize GenAI applications (LLM-powered services) for real business use-cases, with focus on accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
Hands-on prompt engineering (e.g., zero/few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, Tree-of-Thought, prompt templates) and ability to evaluate and refine prompts based on output quality.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including retrieval strategy integration and prompt + retrieval orchestration patterns.
Experience with agent / app evaluation practicesevaluate model and agent performance for GenAI use-cases (quality, effectiveness, benchmarking).
Cloud-based GenAI platform experience (e.g., AWS / Azure / GCP) for building and deploying scalable GenAI solutions with high availability and performance.
MLOps / LLMOps-aligned practices: CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and version control for deploying and operating GenAI systems in production.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, .Net or Java, with experience in relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras).
